job.notes: Kim Guiline is created from the Kukje exhibition page participant list and the Gallery Hyundai name 김기린, born 1936. Kim, Guirin stays unresolved. The 2014 end date is not stored because the Kukje exhibition page says 19 October and the Kukje press PDF says 5 October. Chung Chang-Sub is an alias of Chung Chang-Sup from the Encyves Wiki English name for 정창섭, 1927-2011.

enrichments.title: The Art of Dansaekhwa
enrichments.evidenceShort: The exhibition presents the works of Chung Chang-Sup, Chung Sang-Hwa, Ha Chong-Hyun, Kim Guiline, Lee Ufan, Park Seo-Bo, and Yun Hyong-Keun.
